name: Dust Bunny
emotionalMeaning: Neglected chores

attackPattern.message: Scatters under the utility shelf
Triggers a suspicious sneeze
Rolls with silent accusation

fight.message: You swat it with grim domestic purpose.

dadSkill.message: The dust is unmoved by maturity.

initiative.ambushMessage: Dust Bunny erupts from beneath the utility shelf.

name: Angry Dust Bunny
emotionalMeaning: Neglect with a grudge

attackPattern.message: Hurls itself at Dad with absolute personal grievance
Performs a dramatic rolling charge straight at Dad's ankles
Emits a cloud of malicious lint
Stares Dad down with the fury of years of neglect

fight.message: You swat it. It bounces back. It is angrier now.

dadSkill.message: The dust bunny takes this as an insult.

initiative.ambushMessage: An Angry Dust Bunny launches itself from beneath the dryer before Dad can react.

name: Freaky Icky Spider
emotionalMeaning: Primal fear of things with too many legs

attackPattern.message: Skitters directly toward Dad's shoe
Deploys Too Many Legs in a distressing configuration
Drops from the ceiling at approximately face height
Freezes and stares. Dad stares back. Damage is mostly emotional.

fight.message: Dad strikes with the authority of a man who has seen enough legs.

dadSkill.message: The spider uses this opportunity to move closer.

initiative.ambushMessage: The Freaky Icky Spider drops from the ceiling directly above Dad.

name: Evil Heating Coil
emotionalMeaning: Appliance dread

attackPattern.message: casts Badass Zap
surges with fully powered appliance hatred
throws live current like it pays the mortgage

fight.message: You strike the coil. It flexes like a warranty exclusion.

dadSkill.message: The coil briefly remembers it was manufactured to serve.

initiative.ambushMessage: The Evil Heating Coil glows before you can brace yourself.

runMessages.success:
Dad dives away from the live dryer.
Somehow, dignity escapes too.
runMessages.fail:
Dad looks for an exit.
The coil blocks the retreat.

attackPattern.message: casts Static Shock of a Random Sock
crackles with low-power spite
snaps with unplugged-but-still-angry static

runMessages.success:
Dad retreats with uncommon wisdom.
The powered-down coil cannot stop him.

name: Single-Ply Sam
emotionalMeaning: Cheapskate college days, unresolved

attackPattern.message: Unspools dramatically and gets everywhere
Disintegrates ominously mid-fight, which is somehow worse
Rolls under the cabinet, daring Dad to chase it

fight.message: You swat it. It tears apart with shameful ease.

dadSkill.message: Sam was never going to make it anyway.

initiative.ambushMessage: Single-Ply Sam unrolls from behind the cabinet before Dad can react.

name: Olfactory Ninja
emotionalMeaning: A stink bomb waiting to happen

attackPattern.message: Vanishes in a cloud of pure offense
Deploys a silent-but-deadly smoke bomb
Strikes from the shadows of the exhaust fan

fight.message: Dad swings through the cloud, mostly out of spite.

dadSkill.message: Tactically, this was a mistake in here.

initiative.ambushMessage: The Olfactory Ninja strikes before Dad even registers the smell.

name: Toothpaste Slime
emotionalMeaning: Sticky, minty resentment

attackPattern.message: Oozes onto Dad's shoe with minty menace
Sticks Dad's fingers together in a show of dominance
Sprays a fine mist of fluoride-scented contempt

fight.message: Dad strikes. It splatters, then reforms, vaguely smug.

dadSkill.message: The slime takes this personally.

initiative.ambushMessage: The Toothpaste Slime drops from the medicine cabinet shelf.

name: Mold Patch
emotionalMeaning: Creeping, patient grime

attackPattern.message: Spreads slightly, somehow making the grout worse
Releases a spore cloud of pure landlord-deposit dread
Just sits there, multiplying, judging

fight.message: You scrub it. It clings to the grout with quiet defiance.

dadSkill.message: The mold does not care about your feelings.

initiative.ambushMessage: The Mold Patch has been waiting behind the shower curtain the entire time.

name: Clogged Toilet
emotionalMeaning: Plumbing dread

attackPattern.message: Gurgles with rising, deeply concerning pressure
Threatens to overflow with biblical confidence
Backs up in a way that voids several warranties

fight.message: Dad strikes the bowl. It gurgles in defiance.

dadSkill.message: Porcelain Courage surges within him. The clog briefly considers its life choices.

initiative.ambushMessage: The Clogged Toilet groans ominously before Dad can brace himself.

name: Stink Bug
emotionalMeaning: Something smells and nobody will admit it

attackPattern.message: releases a defensive odor of overwhelming confidence
bonks into Dad's forehead on purpose
clings to Dad's shirt and refuses to leave

fight.message: Dad flicks it with practiced suburban disdain.

dadSkill.message: The bug is unmoved by sighing. It smells worse now.

initiative.ambushMessage: A Stink Bug drops from the light fixture onto Dad's neck.

name: Rusty Garage Spider
emotionalMeaning: The spider that has outlived three owners

attackPattern.message: bites with tetanus-adjacent energy
rappels down and lands on Dad's face
stares with eight disappointed eyes

fight.message: Dad swats. The spider respects the effort.

dadSkill.message: The spider has heard worse sighs. From the previous owner.

initiative.ambushMessage: Something rust-colored was already on Dad's shoulder.

name: Damp Basement Spider
emotionalMeaning: Moisture with legs

attackPattern.message: drips on Dad from directly above
scuttles up Dad's pant leg
weaves a web across the only light switch

fight.message: Dad swings. It is wet, which makes everything worse.

dadSkill.message: The spider is too damp to be emotionally reached.

initiative.ambushMessage: A Damp Basement Spider lands in Dad's hair. It is cold.

name: Lint Lord
emotionalMeaning: Every dryer cycle you skipped cleaning the trap

attackPattern.message: smothers Dad in a fluffy gray tide
summons the lint of a thousand socks
radiates a dry, static resentment

fight.message: Dad punches the lint. Some of it is now in his mouth.

dadSkill.message: The Lint Lord absorbs the sigh. It grows slightly.

initiative.ambushMessage: The Lint Lord rises from behind the water heater, crowned in dryer fuzz.

name: Sump Slime
emotionalMeaning: The sump pump's quiet failure

attackPattern.message: gurgles a wave of mystery water at Dad's socks
splashes a smell that will follow Dad upstairs
engulfs one of Dad's slippers forever

fight.message: Dad hits it. It hits back with the texture of regret.

dadSkill.message: The slime does not know what a sigh is.

initiative.ambushMessage: Something in the sump pit lurches up the wall.

name: Black Mold
emotionalMeaning: The spot behind the toilet you pretend is grout

attackPattern.message: releases spores of quiet dread
spreads across Dad's confidence
whispers about the cost of remediation

fight.message: Dad scrubs with his fist. The mold feels seen.

dadSkill.message: The mold has been ignored for years. A sigh changes nothing.

initiative.ambushMessage: The dark corner of the tub was never grout. It was waiting.

name: Golden Roll
emotionalMeaning: The last roll of the good stuff. It knows its worth.

attackPattern.message: unrolls a single quilted sheet of pure condescension
rolls just out of reach, smugly

fight.message: Dad lunges. Somehow, contact.

dadSkill.message: The Golden Roll has never needed Dad's approval.

initiative.ambushMessage: The Golden Roll was never in a hurry.

name: Crabgrass Creeper
emotionalMeaning: It was here before the house. It will be here after.

attackPattern.message: spreads one more inch while Dad watches
roots itself in Dad's sock
chokes out a perfectly good patch of fescue

fight.message: Dad yanks a fistful of it. Some of it lets go.

dadSkill.message: Crabgrass does not respond to tone of voice.

initiative.ambushMessage: Crabgrass Creeper was already here. It was always already here.

name: Dandelion Puff
emotionalMeaning: Every wish ever made on it was for more dandelions

attackPattern.message: releases fifty tiny parachutes of doom
goes to seed directly in Dad's face
smiles, which is somehow worse

fight.message: Dad swings. Half of it floats away and lands somewhere worse.

dadSkill.message: Dad sighs. The puff loses three seeds to the breeze.

initiative.ambushMessage: A Dandelion Puff drifts into Dad's path on purpose.

name: Lawn Grub
emotionalMeaning: The reason the moles came. The root of the root problem.

attackPattern.message: curls up and eats a root, loudly
wriggles in a way Dad will see when he closes his eyes
burps up thatch

fight.message: Dad digs it out. It is bigger than it looked. They always are.

dadSkill.message: The grub does not know what a Dad is.

initiative.ambushMessage: The soil heaves. A Lawn Grub surfaces like a bad thought.

name: Fire Ant Mound
emotionalMeaning: A thousand small problems acting as one big one

attackPattern.message: sends a scout up Dad's pant leg
swarms with grim efficiency
bites in a coordinated union action

fight.message: Dad flattens the mound. The mound reorganizes.

dadSkill.message: The ants have a queen. She outranks Dad.

initiative.ambushMessage: Dad stepped on it. Of course Dad stepped on it.

name: Rogue Sprinkler Head
emotionalMeaning: Waters the driveway at 5 AM and nothing else

attackPattern.message: pops up and hoses Dad at point-blank range
hisses like a disappointed father-in-law
sprays everywhere except the lawn

fight.message: Dad whacks the nozzle. It spins faster out of spite.

dadSkill.message: Dad tries to reason with the timer. The timer has no menu.

initiative.ambushMessage: Click. Tick-tick-tick. The Rogue Sprinkler Head rises.

name: Vole Lieutenant
emotionalMeaning: Middle management of the underground

attackPattern.message: salutes, then bites
calls in a tunnel collapse
cites the Mole King's standing orders

fight.message: Dad shovels at the lieutenant. It files a complaint.

dadSkill.message: Dad pulls rank. The vole has a hat. The hat wins.

initiative.ambushMessage: A Vole Lieutenant steps out of the dark and checks a tiny clipboard.

name: Lucky Clover
emotionalMeaning: One in ten thousand. It knows.

attackPattern.message: rustles smugly
is lucky at Dad

fight.message: Dad grabs for it. Somehow, contact.

dadSkill.message: The clover is too lucky for that.

initiative.ambushMessage: Four leaves. Dad has never seen four leaves. It sees Dad back.

name: The Mole King
emotionalMeaning: Violated suburban pride, wearing a crown

attackPattern.message: rakes the floor with royal claws
collapses a tunnel onto Dad's position
burrows away and bursts up behind Dad

fight.message: Dad swings at the King. The King sinks into the soil.

dadSkill.message: The Mole King cannot see Dad's glare. He is a mole.

initiative.ambushMessage: The floor of the throne room bulges. The Mole King rises.

modifiers.startMessage: The Mole King smells the castor oil. His whiskers droop.
